messages:
Elena (support): FYI we have a customer on enterprise tier reporting p99 spikes (800-1200ms) on /v1/chat with function/tool calling + structured output enabled since ~09:40 UTC. Escalating.
Jun (eng-runtime): thanks, can you paste a sample request and timestamps?
Elena (support): minimal repro from the customer: 
```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"get_order_status"}],"tools":[{"name":"order_api","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"details":{"type":"object"}}}}],"tool_calling":true,"structured_output":true}'
```
Elena (support): They reported p95 ~ 220ms (normal) but p99 jumped to 1.1s. Happens intermittently on bursts.
ops-bot: Alert: Latency spike detected in service=tool-router env=prod window=09:38-09:46 p99=1123ms p95=235ms
Maya (infra): any recent deploys to router/validator?
Elena (support): No customer-facing deploys in last 6h. Only config rollouts.
Jun (eng-runtime): I pulled the request id from their logs. Quick grep shows schema-validator call took 600-900ms on the tail for some requests, synchronous call inline with routing. Sample excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:42:11Z] request=abc123 route=tool-router validate_schema start=09:42:11.123 end=09:42:12.045 duration=922ms
```
Alex (eng-ml): That smells like the JSON-schema validator doing expensive "allOf" checks on large nested schemas. We recently merged the stricter schema for order_api. Could be combinatorial blowup on certain inputs.
Jun (eng-runtime): Can we repro locally with the customer's payload+schema? If validator is synchronous it will amplify tail latency under bursts.
Elena (support): Customer provided payload + schema privately in ticket. Dropped it into a local test. I see replication: single-threaded validator run spikes to ~700ms occasionally.
Maya (infra): Node running validator looks CPU-bound; container CPU jumps to 95% during validation spikes.
Jun (eng-runtime): action plan: 1) add short-term mitigation: route this customer's requests to a dedicated lighter-path that disables strict validation (fast path) and enables async validation + background audit. 2) Increase router replica count for 30m. 3) Revise validator to use precompiled/compiled validators (ajv with codegen) or move to worker pool.
Alex (eng-ml): Also recommend adding a schema cache keyed by schema fingerprint; avoid recompiling on each request. For nested refs, resolve once.
Elena (support): Customer requested ETA for fix, they are seeing impact on UI. What do we tell them?
Jun (eng-runtime): Tell them we're doing an immediate routing bypass (per-customer fast path) and monitoring. ETA for mitigation rollout: 10-15m. Longer-term fixes: worker pool + precompile in ~2-3 days.
Maya (infra): Rolling bypass: added routing rule to send their requests to route=tool-router-fast (no strict validation). New rule deployed at 09:55 UTC.
ops-bot: Deploy notice: routing-config v2026.03.17.0955 applied by Maya; affected customer IDs: corp-1234
Elena (support): Customer confirms latency dropped to p99 ~250ms after bypass. They asked if this weakens safety.
Jun (eng-runtime): The bypass keeps a permissive validator that checks minimal structural constraints (required top-level keys) but defers full schema check to async job. We will surface audit logs.
Alex (eng-ml): Add to backlog: 1) migrate validator to compiled AJV codegen + wasm sandbox; 2) implement schema fingerprint cache; 3) instrument validator span to show compile vs validate time.
Jun (eng-runtime): Quick profiling notes: flamegraphs show ~70% of time in validator.isValid() and JSON.parse when combined with large string props. Synchronous compile on rare paths caused 400ms+ when schema wasn't cached.
Elena (support): I've updated the customer and they want an RFC when you have a plan. Reassigning to Jun for eng plan and Alex for validator changes.
Jun (eng-runtime): I'll draft RFC and include fallback semantics + SLA implications. Also propose a knob in Console to disable strict schema validation per-route.
Maya (infra): Follow-up immediate ops: autoscaler bumped router replicas from 4->8 for 1 hour to soak the burst. Watch p99 on grafana dashboard 'router.latency'
Elena (support): tagging @Jun @Alex and leaving notes in ticket. Thanks all. :pray:
Jun (eng-runtime): Adding postmortem tags and will schedule a quick retro tomorrow.
Maya (infra): Monitoring shows p99 back to baseline 09:58 UTC after bypass + scaling. Closing urgent loop.
Elena (support): I'll send customer summary and mark escalation resolved, pending RFC.
Jun (eng-runtime): Filing issue RW-VAL-324 in repo for compiled validators + cache.
Alex (eng-ml): I'll prototype ajv codegen in a branch and measure median/99th.
Elena (support): Closing thread for now. If any regressions re-open or ping me. :thumbsup:
